title: Run Away
summary: A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.

title: His & Hers
summary: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

title: Seven Dials Mystery
summary: England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

title: Ponies
summary: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.

title: Can This Love Be Translated?
summary: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
summary: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.

title: The Beauty
summary: The world of high fashion turns dark when international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways. FBI Agents Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett are sent to Paris to uncover the truth. As they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a sexually transmitted virus that transforms ordinary people into visions of physical perfection, but with terrifying consequences.

title: Steal
summary: A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.

title: Wonder Man
summary: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

title: Lord of the Flies
summary: After a plane crash, a group of schoolboys find themselves stranded on a tropical island without adults. Ralph is elected leader and, with the help of the intelligent Piggy, strives to maintain order and civilization. Jack, responsible for the signal fire, becomes increasingly focused on hunting and power struggles. This leads to tensions within the group, gradually pushing the boys from hope and structure into chaos and tragedy.

title: Love Story
summary: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

title: RJ Decker
summary: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

title: Young Sherlock
summary: Sherlock Holmes is a disgraced young man, raw and unfiltered, when he finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy that changes his life forever.

title: Vladimir
summary: When an English professor becomes obsessed with a handsome new colleague, her already complicated marriage and career are thrown into total chaos.

title: Scarpetta
summary: Renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Kay Scarpetta returns to her position as Virginia's Chief Medical Examiner, where she investigates a haunting murder with eerie reminders from her first big case decades ago. In 1998, Scarpetta works alongside Detective Pete Marino and FBI Agent Benton Wesley as they investigate a series of brutal stranglings. Based on the best-selling novels by Patricia Cornwell.

title: The Madison
summary: The Clyburns uproot their comfortable New York City lives to the wild, untamed beauty of Montana's Madison River Valley on a search for connection.

title: The Other Bennet Sister
summary: Mary isn't your typical period drama heroine. She is awkward, anxious, preachy, full of facts, a terrible singer, overlooked by her mother and seemingly destined to an empty dance card for the rest of her life… until Mary takes matters into her own hands.

title: Jo Nesbø's Detective Hole
summary: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

title: Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord
summary: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

title: The Testaments
summary: Growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known. As a new generation of young women grapple with the bleak future that awaits them, they will be forced to search for allies, new and old, to help in their fight for freedom.

title: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
summary: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
summary: The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
summary: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

title: Half Man
summary: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

title: If Wishes Could Kill
summary: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

title: Widow's Bay
summary: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

title: Man on Fire
summary: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

title: Off Campus
summary: Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.

title: Dutton Ranch
summary: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

title: The Boroughs
summary: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

title: Spider-Noir
summary: Ben Reilly, an aging and down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life as the city's one and only superhero.

title: Cape Fear
summary: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

title: I Will Find You
summary: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness
summary: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

title: Elle
summary: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

title: Lucky
summary: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
summary: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

title: The Shards
summary: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

title: Sterling Point
summary: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

title: Lanterns
summary: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

title: Neagley
summary: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
summary: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

title: East of Eden
summary: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

title: The Body
summary: After a dance-team initiation gone wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

title: Blade Runner 2099
summary: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

title: Harry Potter
summary: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

title: Vikings
summary: The adventures of Ragnar Lothbrok, a legendary Norse hero, and his family as they rise from farmer to raiders and rulers, exploring new lands and clashing with kingdoms across the Viking world.

title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
summary: Birmingham, 1940. Amid the chaos of the Second World War, Tommy Shelby is drawn back from exile for a final reckoning that will decide the future of his family and his legacy.

title: Project Hail Mary
summary: A lone astronaut wakes up aboard a spacecraft light-years from Earth with no memory of how he got there. As his memory returns, he must solve the mystery of a fading star and find a way to save humanity.

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
summary: Mario and his friends embark on a new intergalactic adventure across strange worlds in the follow-up to The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

title: Michael
summary: A biographical drama following the life, music, and legacy of Michael Jackson, from his early days with the Jackson 5 to his rise as a global superstar.

title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
summary: Miranda Priestly navigates the changing magazine industry and a new professional rivalry as she crosses paths again with Andy Sachs.

title: Mortal Kombat II
summary: The champions of Earthrealm face a new battle against the forces of Outworld, with Johnny Cage joining the fight in the high-stakes tournament.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
summary: The Mandalorian and his young apprentice Grogu undertake a new mission as the New Republic seeks to protect the galaxy from dangerous warlords.

title: Toy Story 5
summary: Woody, Buzz, Jessie, and the rest of the toys face a new challenge as technology changes the way children play.

title: Supergirl
summary: Kara Zor-El sets out on a spacefaring journey that tests her strength, resolve, and understanding of justice.

title: Moana
summary: A live-action reimagining of Moana's ocean-crossing adventure as she answers the call of the sea and sets out to save her people.

title: The Odyssey
summary: A mythic action epic following Odysseus on his long and perilous journey home after the Trojan War.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
summary: Peter Parker faces a new chapter as Spider-Man, navigating life after the world has forgotten his identity.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
summary: Set decades before Katniss Everdeen's story, the film follows young Haymitch Abernathy during the Second Quarter Quell and the events that shape his life.
